newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Halim Mazmin to buy container ships.
newsitem.headline: Halim Mazmin to buy container ships.

text.p: Malaysian shipping firm Halim Mazmin Bhd said it has proposed to buy two container ships for $70 million, to be paid for by $14 million in share subscriptions and the balance in bank borrowings.

In a statement sent on Tuesday to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange, Halim Mazmin said the ships would be acquired from German firm DSR-Senator Ships and Equipment GmbH, and subsequently time-chartered out to DSR-Senator Lines GmbH.
The deal will be done through an alliance between Halim Mazmin and Reederei F. Laeisz GmbH of Germany. Reederei and DSR are part of the Deutsche Seereederei GmbH group of companies.

Under the pact, Halim Mazmin and Reederei have agreed to establish two Malaysian incorporated companies to be known as Jubilee Shipping Sdn Bhd and Patriot Shipping Sdn Bhd to acquire a container ship each from DSR.
Halim Mazmin will hold 76 percent equity interest in both Jubilee Shipping and Patriot Shipping, with the remainder to be held by Reederei.
The two container ships have a carrying capacity of 2,680 TEUs each and currently ply between the United States, Mediterranean ports and Asia.
Halim Mazmin said the proposed acquisition will help it expand its fleet and operations internationally.
The company's stock was suspended on Tuesday and was trading at 14.60 ringgit at 0349 GMT on Wednesday.
